issues: No sign of getting around the measurement. There is no file or network access, no pasted answers, and no use of test labels. The ExtraTrees model is fit only on Xtr and y, and it only predicts on Xte.

Assumption to check: Xtr[:, :nd] assumes the RDKit descriptors are the first nd columns of the feature matrix. The diff doesn't show that part of the file. The SVR line below appears to use nd in the same way, so this is probably consistent. If the columns are in a different order, the result would still be valid but the change wouldn't mean what it says.

The candidate makes two changes at once: it switches ExtraTrees to descriptors only, and it changes max_features from 0.3 to 0.5 and min_samples_leaf from 2 to 1. This makes it hard to tell which change caused what. That doesn't invalidate the result.

The result matches the harness numbers. The candidate scored 0.366 against the incumbent's 0.3652, so it is 0.0008 worse. That is well inside the noise. My recomputed z is -0.0008 / (0.0037*sqrt(1+1/2)) = -0.177, which agrees with the harness value of -0.178 up to rounding. Reject is the right call.
